employerHeroTitle: Support that helps your business grow
employerHeroDesc: We provide verified employees and take over the organization of the employment process so that your company can operate smoothly and without downtime
employerProcessDesc: We organize cooperation in five transparent stages. From the first inquiry to the monthly settlement, we are at your disposal.
step1Desc: We learn about your company's needs and determine the number of people, positions, and duration of cooperation.
step2Desc: We observe the labor market and adjust our actions, ensuring stability and an appropriate staffing level.
step3Desc: We handle HR and payroll documentation, onboarding, and continuous support for temporary employees.
step4Desc: We prepare a clear summary of hours worked, which streamlines settlements.
step5Desc: At the end of each month, we issue a VAT invoice in accordance with the approved timesheet.
employerBenefitsDesc: Cooperation with Carne Group means comprehensive support that facilitates daily company management and helps safely plan development.
benefit1Title: A reliable partner for your company
benefit1Desc: We help build teams based on responsible and verified employees.
benefit2Desc: We provide support regarding attendance, turnover, work organization, and team management.
benefit3Desc: We ensure safe cooperation and constant assistance from labor market specialists.
benefit4Desc: We help adjust the employment level to the actual needs of the enterprise.

aboutWhoDesc: Carne-Group is a temporary employment agency that supports both job seekers and companies in need of verified workers. We combine knowledge of the local market, experience, and an individual approach to every cooperation. We have been operating since 2023, employing workers from the East, i.e., Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, and Kazakhstan.
aboutHQDesc: Our headquarters is located in Toruń, in the heart of Poland. Thanks to our good knowledge of the region, we quickly respond to the needs of employees and employers and help tailor the best solutions to the current market situation.
